verdict.rationale: Figma's own product docs explicitly state its prototyping tools enable building and sharing high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes (figma-docs-16, figma-docs-33), which directly matches the story of wiring screens with clickable interactions. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on specific mechanics like triggers, transitions, and overlays, or independent/hands-on corroboration of the prototyping experience itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of trigger/transition/overlay mechanics, hands-on or community validation of prototyping workflow quality.
